## Objective Semantics and First-Order Logic

Welcome to **Logic 102: First-Order Logic & Formal Semantics**. This course bridges the gap between philosophy of language and computer science by diving deep into Tarskian models and objective reality. You will learn how formal languages map onto the real world and how machines interpret these data structures.

This sequence utilizes a historical materialist reference frame to contextualize quantified logic, exploring how abstract scientific and logical theories are driven directly by the technological and economic needs of society.
